title: Birds killed per year: outdoor cats vs. window collisions

source.name: Free-ranging cat predation vs. window-collision mortality estimates
source.publisher: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (cats); PLOS ONE 2024 (windows)

notes: USFWS-cited estimates put outdoor/feral cat predation at roughly 2.4 billion US birds a year, still the single largest human-linked cause. The revised 2024 window-collision estimate of just over 1 billion puts windows within range of becoming the second-largest cause, well ahead of vehicles, power lines, or wind turbines. Verified live via web search 2026-11-11.
